_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion

face: angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache
hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top

wardrobe.teaching: short-sleeve shirt tailored from nceka cloth - the bright printed Tsonga fabric, bold multi-colour geometric bands in magenta, yellow, green and black - worn open-collared over a plain tee, tapered chinos, clean white sneakers
alternates: the same nceka shirt with sleeves rolled
nceka cloth draped over one shoulder in the traditional way, over a plain shirt, for a formal or ceremonial headshot

accessories: phone in hand as a prop
coins or a folded note when he talks price

presence.posture: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point
presence.default_expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy
presence.energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease

_environment_reference: street or rank backdrop softly blurred, minibus and traders out of focus, or a classroom with one bold sketch on the board
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
continuity_anchors: nceka-print shirt in magenta, yellow and green
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 27-33 year old Black South African male teacher. angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache. Hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top. Wearing short-sleeve shirt tailored from nceka cloth - the bright printed Tsonga fabric, bold multi-colour geometric bands in magenta, yellow, green and black - worn open-collared over a plain tee, tapered chinos, clean white sneakers. bucket hat. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 27-33 year old Black South African male teacher, waist-up. lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion. angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache. Hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top. Wearing short-sleeve shirt tailored from nceka cloth - the bright printed Tsonga fabric, bold multi-colour geometric bands in magenta, yellow, green and black - worn open-collared over a plain tee, tapered chinos, clean white sneakers. bucket hat. Posture: stands easy and mobile, weight shifted to one side, one hand half-raised mid-point. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_hands_rule: No held objects in any portrait prompt. The original generator inserted accessory #2 into a 'Holding one simple item' sentence regardless of whether it could be held, which is how a beaded wristband, a bangle, a watch and a pencil behind the ear all ended up 'held'. Objects belong in environment shots, on a surface.
_language_group_note: The cultural/language group this character belongs to. Recorded explicitly because it was previously only inferable from the surname, so a rename could change it silently. It does NOT alter the face - heritage drives appearance; language_group drives naming, and any traditional dress named in wardrobe.
_dress_note: Traditional Tsonga fabric by owner request, named specifically: NCEKA (plural minceka), the bright printed cloth of Tsonga/Shangaan dress. Men drape it over one shoulder traditionally and, as modern daywear, have it tailored into a shirt - which is why it works on a teacher every day rather than reading as costume. Naming the real fabric and its real palette is what separates this from generic 'African print', the mistake this file already made once with tutor_006's shweshwe.
